tagline.en: Bulk delete Google Photos and find the look-alike duplicates Google misses. A free Chrome extension that dry-runs first and scans in your browser.
tagline.zh-Hant: 批量刪除 Google 相簿的相片，並找出 Google 漏掉的相似重複相片。免費 Chrome 擴充功能，先模擬執行，並在你的瀏覽器內掃描。

source.note: Runs on Sylphx: pixzy.ai is the web service declared in the repository root sylphx.toml. Name and one-liner follow the product's own site and Chrome Web Store listing (jiahfbbfpacpolomdjlpdpiljllcdenb).
